description:
Ask WhatsApp for this contact's current name.

Only the name is refreshed. The profile picture updates on its own the
next time this number exchanges a message with the contact, and this
does not change how messages reach them.

It answers right away with `requested_at`; the refresh then runs in the
background. Call `get_contact` and read `refresh`: when `completed_at`
is set, `outcome` says what happened (`updated` means the name changed,
`unchanged` means it was already current, `number_not_connected` means
the number was offline, `unavailable` means WhatsApp did not answer).

This is the one contact tool that is not read-only: it queries WhatsApp
over the live connection and spends the organization's per-minute
refresh budget, so it needs a key with contacts write access. Do not
call it in a loop over a list. Refresh the one contact whose name looks
stale.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
